title.zh: 【Binance.US CEO：平台用户资金不受币安被盗事件影响，双方资产托管完全独立】
title.en: 【Binance.US CEO：平台用户资金不受币安被盗事件影响，双方资产托管完全独立】

current_state.zh: Binance.US CEO Steve Gregory said Binance.US user funds are fully segregated and unaffected by the Binance attack because the two exchanges do not share asset custody.
current_state.en: Binance.US CEO Steve Gregory said Binance.US user funds are fully segregated and unaffected by the Binance attack because the two exchanges do not share asset custody.
